questions.stemHtml: A 28-year-old swimming pool worker presents to the dermatology clinic with a lesion on his left hand which is mostly painless but has gradually increased in size as shown in the image. He recalls sustaining a minor cut while cleaning a pool about a month ago. Which of the following is a characteristic feature of this condition?

options.label: B
options.text: Non tender, erythematous nodules along lymphatic vessels

options.label: C
options.text: Vesicular rash with a linear distribution
